verdict.rationale: Linear documents a public GraphQL API. It supports introspection of the full schema, personal API keys and OAuth2 authentication, a typed TypeScript SDK, and public exploration via Apollo Studio. It also offers an agents developer platform and an official MCP server for agent-driven reads and changes. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of real-world API usage, and documentation of rate limits and coverage of operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: It supports introspection so you can query the whole schema.
The Linear API supports personal API keys and OAuth2 authentication.
Our GraphQL API is explorable and queryable via [Apollo Studio](https://studio.apollographql.com/public/Linear-API/variant/current/home), no download or log in required.
You can build agents for internal use within your own workspace or for distribution to other organizations.
